title: Fix mobile dropdown scrolling and enhance UI with professional images and premium gradient background

requirements.text: Replace all 8 service category card images in ServiceCategoryGrid component with real professional service photos: pest control technician spraying house, carpenter working on furniture, professional home cleaning in action, electrician fixing switch/wiring, AC technician servicing air conditioning unit, washing machine/fridge repair technician working, plumber fixing sink/pipe, painter rolling paint on wall. Use uploaded images if available, otherwise generate or select high-quality stock photos. Ensure each category has a distinct, realistic, service-relevant image with object-fit: cover, consistent height, rounded corners, and no cartoons, illustrations, grey placeholders, or broken images.

quotes: Replace ALL subcategory images with real professional photos (NO cartoons, NO illustrations)
Use different images for each service

acceptanceCriteria: All 8 category cards display realistic professional service photos
Images use object-fit: cover with consistent height
No cartoon illustrations, grey placeholders, or broken images
Each service category has a distinct unique image
Images load correctly on desktop and mobile

requirements.text: Change global background theme from plain white to premium subtle gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f8fb 0%, #eef3f9 50%, #f1f5f9 100%) applied to body element across all pages (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews). Keep all cards white with soft shadows. Do not change button colors, navbar colors, or text colors. Maintain professional clean service-app style.

quotes: Use subtle premium gradient: body background: linear-gradient(180deg,#f6f8fb,#eef3f9)
Cards remain white with soft shadow

acceptanceCriteria: Background gradient applied to body element across all pages
Cards remain white with soft shadows
Button colors and navbar colors unchanged
Text colors remain legible and unchanged
Professional clean appearance maintained

requirements.text: Fix service dropdown mobile scrolling issue on Booking page and Reviews page by applying max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain to the dropdown menu element. Set z-index: 9999 on dropdown to ensure it appears above all other elements. Prevent page body scroll when dropdown is open on mobile devices.

quotes: Service dropdown must scroll on mobile
Prevent page scroll while dropdown open

acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown scrolls smoothly on mobile devices (Android and iOS)
Dropdown has max-height of 260px with vertical scrolling
Touch scrolling works smoothly with -webkit-overflow-scrolling
Dropdown appears above all other elements (z-index: 9999)
Page body does not scroll when dropdown is open
Dropdown does not close when attempting to scroll within it

requirements.text: Add smooth hover lift effect to all service cards with transform: translateY(-6px), transition: 0.3s ease, and enhanced soft shadow on hover. Keep existing card colors and text styling unchanged. Apply this effect to service cards on Services page and Pricing page.

quotes: Add smooth hover lift effect: transform: translateY(-6px); transition: .3s ease

acceptanceCriteria: Service cards lift by 6px on hover
Transition animation is smooth with 0.3s duration
Soft shadow appears on hover
Existing card colors remain unchanged
Effect applies to both Services and Pricing pages

requirements.text: Verify and ensure booking form on Booking page works correctly: form should open WhatsApp at https://wa.me/918884447229 with pre-filled message containing Name, Phone, Service, Address, and Date/Message fields. Verify form submission stores booking data in Motoko backend and email notifications remain active. Do not change form layout or styling.

quotes: Ensure form sends WhatsApp message with: Name Phone Service Address Date

acceptanceCriteria: Form opens WhatsApp link with pre-filled booking details
WhatsApp message includes Name, Phone, Service, Address, Date/Message
Booking submission stores data in Motoko backend
Email notifications remain functional
Form layout and styling unchanged

requirements.text: Optimize all service and category images for faster loading by compressing image files and implementing lazy loading for service card images on Services page and Pricing page. Ensure images maintain quality while reducing file size.
acceptanceCriteria: All service images are optimized and compressed
Lazy loading implemented for service card images
Page load time improves on mobile and desktop
Image quality remains acceptable
Images load progressively as user scrolls
